## Accepted result and exact scope

Accept a COMPLETE counterexample to the literal unrestricted local-action fibre-product question, 30001113 / OWR-2492-004. The same argument covers introductory formulation 30001112 / OWR-2492-003; this is one result and one shared 1/5 route budget, with zero new proof-search turns added by this publication.

Take k=F4, G=(F4,+), N=F2 and the faithful action rho(a)(t)=t/(1+a*t). The invariant coordinate y=t^2/(1+t) gives quotient action sigma(y)=y/(1+y). An actual j-fixed class over k[e]/e^3 forces every natural map from D_Q to a prorepresentable F to kill a NONZERO tangent v. The full formal-series equivariant derivation calculation proves the tangent restriction to D_N is injective. Consequently (0,v) belongs to every proposed fibre product but has no preimage, so smoothness fails already at k[e]/e^2 to k.

The actual source category is local Artinian W(k)-algebras, allowing nilpotent constant terms in coordinate automorphisms. Neither printed question assumes D_N or D_Q prorepresentable; separate conditional obstruction-space statements do. This does not answer the amended additional-prorepresentability, pointed, framed or groupoid problems.

The additive weakly ramified action family t/(u*t+1) is also prior: Byszewski-Cornelissen-Tijsma, Journal of Algebra 602 (2022), Proposition 8.1.1, [arXiv:2008.04971](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.04971). Neither this family nor the 2009 conjugacy is claimed new; the full factorization obstruction is the audited deduction, with no novelty guarantee.

The complete proof current/COUNTEREXAMPLE.md and full independent current/INDEPENDENT_AUDIT.md retain their accepted bytes. The precision patch clarifies the direction of the conjugator in the source's reversed substitution-composition convention. The original assert-based checker is not operative; its correction replaces assertions with explicit failures. The superseded full proof and checker, redundant historical validation receipt and old runner are omitted.

## Attribution and source evidence

The characteristic-two involution conjugacy is credited to Jakub Byszewski and Gunther Cornelissen, *Which weakly ramified group actions admit a universal formal deformation?*, Annales de l'Institut Fourier 59 (2009), 877-902, Proposition 4.1, [public PDF](https://www.numdam.org/article/AIF_2009__59_3_877_0.pdf). The full negative factorization argument was not located in bounded searches, but no novelty guarantee, exhaustive later-literature coverage, journal acceptance or formal certification is claimed.

Exact target definitions/formulations: Byszewski, *Dévissage for local deformation functors*, [OWR 54/2008, pp.3038-3040](https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46200), and *Deformation functors of local actions*, [arXiv:1112.0352v1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1112.0352v1), especially definitions and Question 4.4. Historical public metadata preserves the audit's source sizes, hashes, matching results and inspected pages. That recorded retrieval/inspection history is not a fresh publication-stage source search. No source bodies are republished.

## Fresh finite replay and acceptance boundary

The corrected explicit checker verifies Artinian matrix conjugacy and involution. The independent checker verifies all sixteen F4 group-composition identities, quotient invariance/action/derivative, rational invariant/coboundary identities for z^0 through z^8, Artinian conjugacy/involution and all sixty-four ring elements for the j-fixed coefficient condition. The finite checks support but do not prove the infinite formal-series, cohomology, nonzero-tangent or naturality arguments; those require the complete written proofs.

Fresh isolated normal/-O/-OO suites each have two positive checker cases and eight intended algebra mutant rejections: two corrected-checker source mutations and six independent mutants. Totals are six positives and twenty-four intentional rejections. All full raw stdout/stderr and exit codes match fixed mode-specific contracts and references without normalization. Recursive exact JSON types, case identities, counts and intended error reasons are required. The small corrected-checker reporting adapter catches intended RuntimeErrors into deterministic JSON before subprocess output is captured; raw captured bytes are then compared without rewriting. Extra control/baseline/hostile replays are not counted as additional mathematical cases.

Both correction patches were also applied locally with zero fuzz and reproduced the exact accepted corrected bytes. Full superseded authored bases are omitted; patch application from this delivered packet alone is NOT_RUN. Historical receipt, full historical audit harness, pre-seal capture harness, excluded superseded checker, source-body, new-source-search, source-classification, dataset and formal-proof-assistant replay stages are explicitly NOT_RUN. Pre-seal references and their capture receipt are authenticated data; final sealed finite replay is fresh and separate.

## External noncircular trust chain

Authenticate BOOTSTRAP.py using its independent SHA-256 below, then copy the authenticated file outside the packet. Set all delivered files to 0444 and directories to 0555. Use actual UID=EUID=1000:

- python -I -S -B /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -O /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet
- python -I -S -B -OO /trusted/BOOTSTRAP.py --controls /path/to/packet

The fixed external bootstrap authenticates manifest, verifier and control harness before execution. The manifest binds every other delivered file, including historical metadata, the pre-seal capture receipt, contracts and raw references. Bootstrap and manifest are excluded from self-inventory: bootstrap binds manifest, while this separately reviewed PR body pins bootstrap. Final receipts stay outside the inventory, avoiding circular hashes. CPython 3.12.14 and its standard library remain trusted dependencies; local pre-seal patch checking used the system patch executable.

Every mode passes 44 integrity negatives, 63 schema/scope negatives, 30 exact-comparator negatives, 31 actual create/append-open/unlink permission denials, full hostile-import baseline equality and whole-delivery before/after hash equality. These publication controls are separate from algebra mutations. Permission modes deter accidental writes, not intentional owner chmod or root access.

Only the target attempt directory is added. No QUEUE, unrelated paths, source PDFs/text/images, dataset contents, private sources/coordination, or identifying metadata for excluded private files are included.
